title: Issue #4712: set-code + eval-current clears the whole IR define cid->name index, so an untouched sibling workspace define (still bound in top_env, no dirty row) lost its dispatch route and every caller read 'eval_flat: invalid closure' - a fiber spawned before the replace aborted the process.
ok: OK: Issue #4712 sibling workspace IR define stays dispatchable across set-code - dispatch resolves a cleared-index id to the live binding that owns it
